alternatives.option: Use the pure function with supplied context and the fresh worklist; keep the registered predicate unchanged.

consequences: Do not describe rule3 agreement as unconditional agreement for arbitrarily manufactured stored items.
If a persisted-item production consumer appears, return the gate-context question to requirement authority before claiming agreement.
context: The pure satisfying function can close an old superseded item when supplied context, but its registered gate caller supplies only rows. The implementation computes a fresh worklist and suppresses that item before judging, so wiring context would broaden the task and depart from the taken implementation without protecting an actual production path.
